title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
A 23-year-old Chinese student is on trial in Zurich for attempted murder after stabbing three five-year-old boys at a childcare center in Oerlikon on 1 October 2024. One boy had a major vein in his neck completely cut and needed emergency surgery, another suffered two chest wounds that damaged his heart and arteries and nearly died, and the third was injured in his ear and lung. A daycare worker grabbed the attacker's arms, forcing him to drop the knife and surrender before passersby held him for police.

Prosecutors say he planned the attack for weeks, using ChatGPT to ask about legal consequences of stabbing random victims, choosing children, ordering knives and clothing, studying anatomy, and buying raw beef to practice stabbing the day before. He acted on China's national day and posted patriotic and insulting messages just before the attack. The prosecution calls the crime exceptionally cold-blooded and is seeking a 15-year prison sentence and a 15-year expulsion order. The court hearing began Thursday.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
